vocabulary.meaning_en: belonging to me (I)
vocabulary.note_ar: تأتي من الضمير I، ويأتي بعدها اسم دائمًا: my book = كتابي
vocabulary.note_en: Comes from I. A noun always follows it: my book.

vocabulary.meaning_en: belonging to you (one person or more)
vocabulary.note_ar: تأتي من you، وتُستخدم للمفرد والجمع
vocabulary.note_en: Comes from you. Same word for one person or many people.

vocabulary.meaning_en: belonging to him (he)
belonging to her (she)
belonging to an animal or a thing (it)
vocabulary.note_ar: تأتي من it، ولا تُكتب بفاصلة عليا: its وليس it's
vocabulary.note_en: Comes from it. No apostrophe: its, not it's.
vocabulary.example: The cat is playing with its ball.

vocabulary.meaning_en: belonging to us (we)
vocabulary.note_ar: تأتي من we، وتُنطق تقريبًا مثل كلمة hour
vocabulary.note_en: Comes from we. It sounds like "hour".

vocabulary.meaning_en: belonging to them (they)
vocabulary.note_ar: تأتي من they، وتُستخدم للعاقل وغير العاقل
vocabulary.note_en: Comes from they. Use it for people, animals and things.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a word before a noun that shows who owns it
vocabulary.note_ar: my, your, his, her, its, our, their
vocabulary.note_en: my, your, his, her, its, our, their

vocabulary.meaning_en: a word that does the action, before a verb
vocabulary.note_ar: I, you, he, she, it, we, they
vocabulary.note_en: I, you, he, she, it, we, they

fine_lines.title: I vs my
fine_lines.explanation_ar: I ضمير فاعل يأتي بعده فعل (I like). أما my فهي صفة ملكية يأتي بعدها اسم (my car). لا نقول I car.
fine_lines.explanation_en: I is a subject pronoun: a verb comes after it (I like). My is a possessive adjective: a noun comes after it (my car). Never say "I car".

fine_lines.title: his vs her
fine_lines.explanation_ar: his للمالك المذكر (ملكه)، و her للمالكة المؤنثة (ملكها). العبرة بالمالك وليس بالشيء المملوك.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Use his when the owner is a boy or a man, and her when the owner is a girl or a woman. Look at the owner, not the thing.

fine_lines.title: its vs it's
fine_lines.explanation_ar: its صفة ملكية لغير الإنسان (ذيله، عيونه). it's اختصار it is (إنه يكون).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Its shows that something belongs to an animal or thing. It's is short for "it is".

examples.sentence: The cat is licking its paw.

fine_lines.title: they vs their
fine_lines.explanation_ar: they ضمير فاعل يأتي بعده فعل، و their صفة ملكية يأتي بعدها اسم.
fine_lines.explanation_en: They is followed by a verb. Their is followed by a noun.

fine_lines.title: we vs our
fine_lines.explanation_ar: we = نحن ويأتي بعده فعل، و our = ـنا ويأتي بعدها اسم.
fine_lines.explanation_en: We is followed by a verb. Our is followed by a noun.

expressions.example: What's your name? My name is Rana.

expressions.meaning_en: Telling someone a boy's or man's name.

expressions.example: Mona is happy. Her friends are kind.
Look at the cat. Its eyes are green.

expressions.meaning_en: A sentence with a subject pronoun and a possessive adjective together.
expressions.example: Every morning, they eat their breakfast.
The dog is happy. The dog wags its tail.

grammar.title: Subject pronouns come before verbs
grammar.explanation_ar: ضمائر الفاعل سبعة: I (أنا)، he (هو)، she (هي)، it (لغير الإنسان)، you (أنت/أنتِ/أنتم)، we (نحن)، they (هم). يأتي بعدها فعل في أي زمن.
grammar.explanation_en: There are seven subject pronouns: I, he, she, it, you, we, they. A verb comes after them, in any tense.

grammar.title: Possessive adjectives come before nouns
grammar.explanation_ar: صفات الملكية تبيّن لمن الشيء، ويأتي بعدها اسم دائمًا: I ← my، you ← your، he ← his، she ← her، it ← its، we ← our، they ← their.
grammar.explanation_en: Possessive adjectives show who owns something, and a noun always comes after them: I → my, you → your, he → his, she → her, it → its, we → our, they → their.

grammar.title: Possessive adjective + noun + is / are
grammar.explanation_ar: اختر الفعل حسب الاسم بعد صفة الملكية وليس حسب الصفة نفسها: اسم مفرد ← is، اسم جمع ← are. وابدأ الجملة بحرف كبير وانهها بنقطة.
grammar.explanation_en: Choose the verb by the noun after the possessive adjective: singular noun → is, plural noun → are. Start with a capital letter and end with a full stop.

grammar.title: Two ways to show possession: have/has and possessive adjectives
grammar.explanation_ar: يمكن التعبير عن الملكية بـ have/has بعد الفاعل، أو بصفة الملكية قبل الاسم. I have a black cat = My cat is black.
grammar.explanation_en: You can show possession with have/has after a subject, or with a possessive adjective before a noun.
examples: I have a black cat. → My cat is black.
Sally has blonde hair. → Her hair is blonde.
We have a car. → Our car is blue.

questions.question: Adam has a bike. It is ___ bike.
questions.explanation_en: Adam is a boy, so we use his.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation_ar: صفة الملكية my يأتي بعدها اسم، و car مفرد فنستخدم is.
questions.explanation_en: My comes before a noun, and car is singular, so we use is.

questions.question: What is the possessive adjective for "we"?
The dog wags ___ tail.
questions.explanation_ar: الكلب غير إنسان، فنستخدم its بدون فاصلة عليا.
questions.explanation_en: A dog is an animal, so we use its (no apostrophe).

questions.question: Rofan is a girl. ___ dress is white.
questions.explanation_ar: روفان بنت، والشيء ملكها: her. أما she فضمير فاعل يأتي بعده فعل.
questions.explanation_en: Rofan is a girl, so we use her. She is followed by a verb, not a noun.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation_ar: they قبل الفعل play، و their قبل الاسم ball.
questions.explanation_en: They comes before the verb play; their comes before the noun ball.

questions.question: Sara and I have a house. It is ___ house.
questions.explanation_ar: أنا وسارة = نحن we، فالصفة our.
questions.explanation_en: Sara and I = we, so we use our.

questions.question: "What's ___ name?" "My name is Ali."
questions.explanation_ar: نسأل الشخص عن اسمه بـ your name.
questions.explanation_en: We ask a person about their own name with your.

questions.question: Her friends ___ kind.
questions.explanation_en: Friends is plural, so we use are.

questions.question: What comes after a possessive adjective?
questions.explanation_ar: صفات الملكية يأتي بعدها اسم، وضمائر الفاعل يأتي بعدها فعل.
questions.explanation_en: A noun comes after a possessive adjective; a verb comes after a subject pronoun.
